mentions.name: AuctionSieve
mentions.description: A web app that makes searching eBay more enjoyable: run a search, then highlight text to trash or group terms, and re-run searches later with previously seen items automatically hidden. Converted from a 23-year-old Java desktop app to a website.
mentions.problem: Searching eBay is tedious because users keep re-seeing items they have already viewed.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://app.auctionsieve.com/

I've converted my 23 year old Java desktop app to a website.

It's an app to make searching eBay an actual joy. Perform a search, then highlight text to trash or group that term. Then perform the search again tomorrow and it will hide all the stuff you've already seen.
